title: Cardinal Billing Account Prepayment Credit Rate by Installments Still to Be Invoiced
content:
**Rule.** The prepayment credit rate on a Cardinal Billing Account term payoff is **1.5 percent** when three or more installments of the term are still to be invoiced, **1.25 percent** when exactly two are, and **1.0 percent** when one or none is.

Installments still to be invoiced are the installments of the term less the installments of the current term already invoiced on the account's billing history (the down payment counts as invoiced).

## Decision matrix

| Installments of the term still to be invoiced | Prepayment credit rate |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 1.5 percent |
| 2 | 1.25 percent |
| 1 | 1.0 percent |
| 0 | 1.0 percent |

**Hypothetical cases.** A six-installment term with installments 1 and 2 invoiced has 4 still to be invoiced: 1.5 percent. With installments 1 to 4 invoiced, 2 remain: 1.25 percent. With installments 1 to 5 invoiced, 1 remains: 1.0 percent. A three-installment term with installment 1 invoiced has 2 still to be invoiced: 1.25 percent.
